extension.summary: 极光6S/4Pro硬件修复、灯条与 eMMC 双系统管理
Aurora 6S/4 Pro hardware, RGB lighting and eMMC management
extension.description: 修复和4pro/6S wifi/蓝牙/灯光，灯光管理，安装、移除安卓/CE双系统，修复双系统启动/布局，以及更换/恢复启动第一屏；6S/4Pro RTL8852 的 NG/NO 支持蓝牙待机唤醒名单、唤醒后恢复和可选有线待机处理

Device-specific fixes and lighting for Aurora 4 Pro and 6S. On supported NO builds: dual-boot installation/removal and full eMMC backup/restore. Includes boot scanner recovery on NG/NO and metadata-only layout recovery on NG/NO with guarded Android 11 full-snapshot OTA target retry on NG/NO. Installation/removal resets Android data.
